title: Scalable Oversight Under Distribution Shift: Does Oversight Quality Degrade Out-of-Domain?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Distribution shift is ubiquitous in deployment. If oversight fails silently under shift, safety guarantees are weaker than reported. Direct safety implication for deployed systems.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Training an overseer on one domain and evaluating on another is a standard transfer learning experiment. Requires domain-specific datasets and some pipeline setup, but conceptually accessible to beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Two domains, one overseer training run, cross-domain evaluation, optional domain adaptation. Manageable scope but the two-domain setup and adaptation experiment stretch the 30-hour budget.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
